facts.text: The hotel sits on the water's edge with views across Wynyard Quarter's Lighter Basin and out to the Waitemata Harbour.

facts.excerpt: The 2021-opened Park Hyatt Auckland looms like a glass palace beside Waitematā Harbor in Wynyard Quarter
